verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own Data Privacy Controls for GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-out. Forwarding rules such as 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present' suppress data flowing to connected destinations, which covers the suppression side of the story. Nothing in the pack shows user deletion/erasure requests being processed or relayed to destinations; the GDPR/CCPA compliance doc appears only as a title. missing for 10: documented deletion/erasure request processing, forwarding of deletion/suppression requests to downstream destinations, request status tracking, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations

citations.quote: Manage your consent and opt-out privacy obligations under the GDPR and CCPA with Data Privacy Controls
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
